workspace.title: Create your workspace
workspace.subtitle: A space for your office — your projects, contacts and files live there, separate from your private space.
workspace.nameHint: This is how your office appears inside the application.
workspace.aliasHint: Letters, digits and hyphen — from {min} to {max} characters. Not easily changed later.
workspace.aliasAuto: Filled in automatically from the name — you can change it.
workspace.youBecomeAdmin: You become the administrator of this workspace.
workspace.privateStays: Your private space stays separate and nobody else can see it.

errors.reserved: That name is reserved by the system. Please choose another.
errors.too-short: Too short — at least {min} characters are required.
errors.invalid-characters: Letters, digits and hyphen are allowed. A hyphen cannot start or end the address.
errors.mixed-script: Write it in one alphabet — Greek or Latin, not mixed.
errors.already-taken: That address is already in use. Please choose another.
errors.look-alike-taken: An address that looks identical already exists. Please choose another.
errors.already-has-workspace: You already belong to an office workspace.
errors.name-required: Please fill in the office name.
errors.registry-unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.
